description: Puerto Rico's water situation right now: every AAA rotation plan in force (metro and local, each with its status active/paused/ended, which zone has water and until when) in `plans`, mayor-announced local rationing in `local`, the metro plan's own detail in `rationing` (next scheduled switch, published calendar), today's 5 AM levels for the 19 AAA-monitored reservoirs with their alert bands and our trend/pace analysis, and the utility's latest notices from @AcueductosPR (translated). Daily data no other source publishes as numbers; cite 787daily.com and AAA.

reservoir.description: Optional reservoir slug to narrow the reservoir list (e.g. 'carraizo', 'la-plata', 'cidra'); omit for all 19
